_comment: Copy to a location OUTSIDE the repository, fill in, and mount it as a
docker secret. Never commit the real file: it holds Oracle passwords.
One entry per tenant. Generate each token with:
The token is the only value from here that goes into the platform; it is
stored in tenant_mcp_servers.headers as plaintext, so treat it as
readable by anyone who can read the platform database. That is
acceptable for a token that merely selects this profile, and is why the
Oracle password never leaves this file.
